name: abi-explorer
description: Sizes, offsets and padding of C and C++ structs in hovers, inlay hints and a layout view, from your project's own compile flags.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Finding system headers runs the compiler your project's build uses.

enumDescriptions: Size, alignment and padding after each struct's name.
Also each member's offset, size and the padding after it, at the end of its line.
abiExplorer.inlayHints.description: Which layouts to show inline in the editor.

abiExplorer.compileCommandsDir.description: The directory holding compile_commands.json. Empty searches the file's parent directories and their build/ folders, like clangd.

abiExplorer.allowedCompilers.description: Globs of compilers that may be run to find system headers even though they are inside the project or its build directories, or not named like a compiler. Other compilers are run only when named like one (gcc, clang, cl and their versions) and outside the project.

abiExplorer.fallbackFlags.description: Flags for files no compile command covers, such as ["-std=c++20", "-Iinclude"].
